import numpy as np

def variants(m):
    x=np.array(m)
    return {'id':x,'r90':np.rot90(x,-1),'r180':np.rot90(x,2),'r270':np.rot90(x,1),'flipud':np.flipud(x),'fliplr':np.fliplr(x),'trans':x.T,'anti':np.fliplr(np.flipud(x.T))}
for i,o in enumerate(out_regs):
    print('out',i)
    for pos,reg in regions.items():
        matches=[k for k,v in variants(reg).items() if np.array_equal(v,o)]
        if matches: print(pos,matches)
